subject: Genetics
title: Prenatal Genetic Testing
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Prenatal Genetic Testing.

hook.text: A blood draw from a pregnant woman can detect fetal chromosomal conditions. No needle enters the womb.

buildup.text: Cell-free fetal DNA floats in the mother's blood. NIPT screens it for trisomies 21, 18, and 13 accurately.

discovery.text: NIPT reduced the need for amniocentesis, which carries a small miscarriage risk. Safer screening for millions.

twist.text: In some countries, high detection rates cut Down syndrome births by 90%. The ethical debate is fierce.

climax.text: Prenatal testing gives parents information—and impossible choices. Medicine provides data; values provide answers.

punchline.text: A blood test reveals the fetus's genes. Then what?
